about: Planted known-bad golden files for validate.mjs --selftest (gate W pattern). Each must exit as stated; GF-06 is the documented boundary: a valid, self-consistent but irrelevant id passes, because relevance is the independent review's job. GF-02..GF-06 are the IF-ID Q1 derivation fixtures IDF-01..IDF-05 (contracts/fixtures/id-derivation.json) in golden-file form. GF-14..GF-19 (review 5b) plant private detail in query, origin, origin_note and provenance; each must fail with its privacy class. GF-20..GF-28 (review 5c) cover the three evasion families (machine-name variants, workflow clauses, private text in why, honest_answer and redaction labels), a field outside the schema, and committed-artifact metadata (a leakage header with generation provenance, a planted file with a path and a machine name). Fixtures marked planted_private carry synthetic private-looking values on purpose; the committed-artifact scan skips exactly those files, and the selftest proves each one fails.
